verdict.rationale: Public-code matching and license references are a fair question for an AI coding agent like Devin, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents license detection or public-code matching references for generated code. Devin Review (correctness and best-practice checks) and responding to SonarQube/Fortify/Veracode findings are adjacent review features, not code-provenance or license matching.
